text: Choose a dark theme as the default with a persistent one-click toggle to light mode. text: Dark themes hide errors and muted colors—users miss critical data if they assume the interface behaves the same as a light theme. A better alternative is a light theme by default with a persistent toggle, forcing users to acknowledge when they switch to dark mode and reducing the risk of oversight. Settle it with a user test: measure error detection rates in both themes before locking in the default.
